Vikki Goodwin

Democratic candidate for Lieutenant Governor, Texas · Challenger

State representative

Austin state representative who flipped a Republican-held House seat in 2018. Won the May 26 runoff with 67.8%. Reported about $643,000 cash on hand in the latest filings.

Where Goodwin stands

Hemp and THC
Opposes the THC ban.
Schools
Wants the state to pay a larger share of public school funding; opposes school vouchers.
Health care
Proposes a state-run public health insurance option paid for partly by a new cannabis tax.
School curriculum
Says school districts should be free to teach diversity, equity and inclusion.
